description: Realty Income Corporation, an S&P 500 company, describes itself as the real estate partner to the world's leading companies, and founded in 1969 it serves its clients as a full-service real estate capital provider, with a portfolio of over 15,500 properties in all 50 states of the United States, the United Kingdom and eight other countries in Europe as of December 31, 2025. It is known as The Monthly Dividend Company and has a mission to invest in people and places to deliver dependable monthly dividends that increase over time, and since its listing on the NYSE in 1994 it has had 133 dividend increases and is a member of the S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats index for having increased its dividend for over 31 consecutive years, with geographic expansion an important component of its investment strategy, where as of December 31, 2025 its U.K. and European assets represented approximately 19 percent of its annualized base rent compared to approximately 14 percent as of December 31, 2024.
